criteria.question: is the escape circuit's readout wiring-specific against a degree-corrected null that can fire?

protocol.stimulus: loom on the declared loom tuning types (loom_protocol), electrical synapses on
protocol.readout: giant fiber (DNp01) response probability: a spike within 160 ms of loom onset, per trial
protocol.null_seed_rule: null draw k = 0..draws-1 rewires with seed 1000 + k (rewire_null, mode degree_corrected)
protocol.stimulus_noise: FLYCNS_SEED, the same in every arm, so the arms differ only in wiring
protocol.alive_rule: median null whole-CNS rate >= 0.1 x real

N1_escape_gf_wiring_specific.rule: the real readout as a percentile of the null draws (stats.null_percentile): PASS if it exceeds every null draw (one-sided p < 1 / (draws + 1)); FAIL if it does not exceed the null median; UNRESOLVED in between, or if the null is not active by the alive rule (it cannot test anything), or if there are no null draws

electrical: shakB gap junction, 1:1 relay; Tanouye & Wyman 1980; Allen et al. 2006
shakB gap junction, 1:1 relay; Allen et al. 2006; Phelan et al. 2008
JON->GF mixed synapse modelled as electrical; shakB-dependent (Pezier et al. 2016); mixed (Pezier et al. 2014); 3 mV target untraced; contact set from MaleCNS v1.0
JON->GF mixed synapse modelled as electrical; shakB-dependent (Pezier et al. 2016); mixed (Pezier et al. 2014); 3 mV target untraced; contact set from MaleCNS v1.0
intrinsic: all-or-none GF response; von Reyn 2014; Ache 2019. Fitted by pre-stated rule (smallest value giving 1-2 spikes/response, <=2 on the strongest gain quartile, P(response) 0.5-1, TTMn relay intact; benchmarks/fit_gf_adapt.py at >=40 trials). 10 mV under the measured stationary loom input (refit 2026-10-10, 40 trials; the strong-quartile constraint holds at 1.95, close to its limit of 2). Earlier 30 mV was fitted under the all-trials input; a 15 mV value came from an undersampled 20-trial fit. 0 mV gives up to 7 spikes per loom.
sustained MN rates < 100 Hz; Azevedo 2020; McKellar 2020
